property_summary: For any non-zero account and any token id the reference contract's balanceOf returns the stored balance _balances[id][account], whereas the mutant returns stored balance + 1 — so the invariant is: balanceOf(account,id) == stored balance (i.e. value consistent with mint/burn effects); the mutant breaks this by adding 1 and thus returning a different value for any account/id where stored balance is not max uint wrapping (i.e. when stored balance is any finite value).
change_summary: Always return stored balance plus one (off-by-one) instead of the stored balance.
